verses.text_en: In the first year of Cyrus king of the Persians, that the word of the Lord might be accomplished, that he had promised by the mouth of Jeremy;
verses.text_hr: Prve godine perzijskoga kralja Kira, da bi se ispunila riječ Gospodnja koju je obećao na usta Jeremijina,

verses.text_en: The Lord raised up the spirit of Cyrus the king of the Persians, and he made proclamation through all his kingdom, and also by writing,
verses.text_hr: Gospodin je potaknuo duh perzijskoga kralja Kira, pa je on po svemu svojem kraljevstvu usmeno i pismeno proglasio:

verses.text_en: Saying, Thus saith Cyrus king of the Persians; The Lord of Israel, the most high Lord, hath made me king of the whole world,
verses.text_hr: „Ovako govori perzijski kralj Kir: Gospodin Izraelov, Svevišnji Gospodin, postavio me za kralja svega svijeta

verses.text_en: And commanded me to build him an house at Jerusalem in Jewry.
verses.text_hr: i zapovjedio mi da mu sagradim Dom u Jeruzalemu, u Judeji.

verses.text_en: If therefore there be any of you that are of his people, let the Lord, even his Lord, be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem that is in Judea, and build the house of the Lord of Israel: for he is the Lord that dwelleth in Jerusalem.
verses.text_hr: Ako među vama ima ikoga od njegova naroda, neka Gospodin, njegov Bog, bude s njim. Neka pođe u Jeruzalem u Judeji i gradi Dom Gospodinu, Bogu Izraelovu, jer on je Gospodin koji prebiva u Jeruzalemu.

verses.text_en: Whosoever then dwell in the places about, let them help him, those, I say, that are his neighbours, with gold, and with silver,
verses.text_hr: A onima koji žive u okolnim mjestima neka pomognu njihovi susjedi zlatom i srebrom,

verses.text_en: With gifts, with horses, and with cattle, and other things, which have been set forth by vow, for the temple of the Lord at Jerusalem.
verses.text_hr: darovima, konjima, stokom i drugim stvarima zavjetovanima za Hram Gospodnji u Jeruzalemu.“

verses.text_en: Then the chief of the families of Judea and of the tribe of Benjamin stood up; the priests also, and the Levites, and all they whose mind the Lord had moved to go up, and to build an house for the Lord at Jerusalem,
verses.text_hr: Tada ustadoše glavari judejskih obitelji i Benjaminova plemena, svećenici i leviti te svi kojima je Gospodin potaknuo srce da pođu graditi Dom Gospodnji u Jeruzalemu.

verses.text_en: And they that dwelt round about them, and helped them in all things with silver and gold, with horses and cattle, and with very many free gifts of a great number whose minds were stirred up thereto.
verses.text_hr: Njihovi su im susjedi pomagali svime: srebrom i zlatom, konjima i stokom te veoma mnogim dragovoljnim darovima brojnih ljudi čija su srca bila potaknuta na to.

verses.text_en: King Cyrus also brought forth the holy vessels, which Nabuchodonosor had carried away from Jerusalem, and had set up in his temple of idols.
verses.text_hr: Kralj Kir iznio je i svete posude koje je Nabukodonozor odnio iz Jeruzalema i postavio u hram svojih idola.

verses.text_en: Now when Cyrus king of the Persians had brought them forth, he delivered them to Mithridates his treasurer:
verses.text_hr: Kad ih je perzijski kralj Kir iznio, predao ih je svojem rizničaru Mitridatu,

verses.text_en: And by him they were delivered to Sanabassar the governor of Judea.
verses.text_hr: a on ih je predao Šešbasaru, upravitelju Judeje.

verses.text_en: And this was the number of them; A thousand golden cups, and a thousand of silver, censers of silver twenty nine, vials of gold thirty, and of silver two thousand four hundred and ten, and a thousand other vessels.
verses.text_hr: Ovo je njihov broj: tisuću zlatnih čaša i tisuću srebrnih; dvadeset i devet srebrnih kadionica; trideset zlatnih zdjela i dvije tisuće četiri stotine i deset srebrnih; te tisuću drugih posuda.

verses.text_en: So all the vessels of gold and of silver, which were carried away, were five thousand four hundred threescore and nine.
verses.text_hr: Svih zlatnih i srebrnih posuda koje su bile odnesene bilo je pet tisuća četiri stotine šezdeset i devet.

verses.text_en: These were brought back by Sanabassar, together with them of the captivity, from Babylon to Jerusalem.
verses.text_hr: Šešbasar ih je s povratnicima iz sužanjstva donio iz Babilona u Jeruzalem.

verses.text_en: But in the time of Artexerxes king of the Persians Belemus, and Mithridates, and Tabellius, and Rathumus, and Beeltethmus, and Semellius the secretary, with others that were in commission with them, dwelling in Samaria and other places, wrote unto him against them that dwelt in Judea and Jerusalem these letters following;
verses.text_hr: Ali u vrijeme perzijskoga kralja Artakserksa Belem, Mitridat, Tabelije, Rehum, Beeltetmo i tajnik Šimšaj, zajedno s ostalim svojim povjerenicima koji su živjeli u Samariji i drugim mjestima, napisali su protiv stanovnika Judeje i Jeruzalema ovo pismo:

verses.text_en: To king Artexerxes our lord, Thy servants, Rathumus the storywriter, and Semellius the scribe, and the rest of their council, and the judges that are in Celosyria and Phenice.
verses.text_hr: „Kralju Artakserksu, gospodaru našemu: tvoje sluge Rehum ljetopisac, pisar Šimšaj, ostali članovi njihova vijeća i suci u Koelesiriji i Feniciji.

verses.text_en: Be it now known to the lord king, that the Jews that are up from you to us, being come into Jerusalem, that rebellious and wicked city, do build the marketplaces, and repair the walls of it and do lay the foundation of the temple.
verses.text_hr: Neka sada gospodaru kralju bude poznato da Židovi koji su od tebe došli k nama i stigli u Jeruzalem, onaj buntovni i opaki grad, obnavljaju njegove trgove i zidine te polažu temelje Hramu.

verses.text_en: Now if this city and the walls thereof be made up again, they will not only refuse to give tribute, but also rebel against kings.
verses.text_hr: Ako taj grad bude ponovno izgrađen i njegove zidine podignute, oni neće samo odbiti plaćati danak nego će se i pobuniti protiv kraljeva.

verses.text_en: And forasmuch as the things pertaining to the temple are now in hand, we think it meet not to neglect such a matter,
verses.text_hr: Budući da su sada u tijeku poslovi oko Hrama, smatramo da takvo što ne smijemo zanemariti,

verses.text_en: But to speak unto our lord the king, to the intent that, if it be thy pleasure it may be sought out in the books of thy fathers:
verses.text_hr: nego o tome obavijestiti gospodara kralja, da se, ako ti je po volji, pretraže knjige tvojih otaca.

verses.text_en: And thou shalt find in the chronicles what is written concerning these things, and shalt understand that that city was rebellious, troubling both kings and cities:
verses.text_hr: U ljetopisima ćeš pronaći što je zapisano o tome i razumjeti da je taj grad bio buntovan te zadavao nevolje kraljevima i gradovima.

verses.text_en: And that the Jews were rebellious, and raised always wars therein; for the which cause even this city was made desolate.
verses.text_hr: Židovi su dizali pobune i neprestano pokretali ratove u njemu; zato je taj grad i bio opustošen.

verses.text_en: Wherefore now we do declare unto thee, O lord the king, that if this city be built again, and the walls thereof set up anew, thou shalt from henceforth have no passage into Celosyria and Phenice.
verses.text_hr: Stoga ti sada izjavljujemo, gospodaru kralju: ako se taj grad ponovno izgradi i njegove zidine podignu, ubuduće više nećeš imati prolaza u Koelesiriju i Feniciju.“

verses.text_en: Then the king wrote back again to Rathumus the storywriter, to Beeltethmus, to Semellius the scribe, and to the rest that were in commission, and dwellers in Samaria and Syria and Phenice, after this manner;
verses.text_hr: Kralj je zatim odgovorio Rehumu ljetopiscu, Beeltetmu, pisaru Šimšaju i ostalim njihovim povjerenicima koji su živjeli u Samariji, Siriji i Feniciji:

verses.text_en: I have read the epistle which ye have sent unto me: therefore I commanded to make diligent search, and it hath been found that that city was from the beginning practising against kings;
verses.text_hr: „Pročitao sam pismo koje ste mi poslali. Po mojoj je zapovijedi obavljena pomna istraga i ustanovljeno je da se taj grad od davnine dizao protiv kraljeva.

verses.text_en: And the men therein were given to rebellion and war: and that mighty kings and fierce were in Jerusalem, who reigned and exacted tributes in Celosyria and Phenice.
verses.text_hr: Njegovi su stanovnici bili skloni pobuni i ratu, a u Jeruzalemu su kraljevali moćni i siloviti kraljevi koji su ubirali danak u Koelesiriji i Feniciji.

verses.text_en: Now therefore I have commanded to hinder those men from building the city, and heed to be taken that there be no more done in it;
verses.text_hr: Zato sam sada zapovjedio da se tim ljudima zabrani gradnja grada i da se pazi kako se ondje ništa više ne bi radilo,

verses.text_en: And that those wicked workers proceed no further to the annoyance of kings,
verses.text_hr: te da ti zlotvori ne nastave nanositi štetu kraljevima.“

verses.text_en: Then king Artexerxes his letters being read, Rathumus, and Semellius the scribe, and the rest that were in commission with them, removing in haste toward Jerusalem with a troop of horsemen and a multitude of people in battle array, began to hinder the builders; and the building of the temple in Jerusalem ceased until the second year of the reign of Darius king of the Persians.
verses.text_hr: Kad su pisma kralja Artakserksa pročitana, Rehum, pisar Šimšaj i ostali njihovi povjerenici žurno su krenuli prema Jeruzalemu s četom konjanika i velikim brojem naoružanih ljudi. Počeli su ometati graditelje, pa je gradnja Hrama u Jeruzalemu prestala sve do druge godine vladavine perzijskoga kralja Darija.
